metaTitle: TLI30325 Cert III Supply Chain Operations RPL
metaDescription: Work in a warehouse or transport? Get the TLI30325 Certificate III in Supply Chain Operations through RPL. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The TLI30325 Certificate III in Supply Chain Operations is the qualification for experienced warehouse, storage, dispatch and transport workers. If you already work in a warehouse or distribution centre, RPL lets you get it using evidence from your job.
whoIsItFor:
• Storepersons, pick-packers and warehouse operators
  • Forklift operators and inventory controllers
  • Receiving and dispatch staff
  • Transport and freight handlers

Candidates usually have six months or more in warehousing or logistics: manual handling, receiving and dispatching goods, stock control, equipment operation and following chain of responsibility rules.
evidenceExamples:
• Licences and tickets, such as a forklift high risk work licence
  • Pick, pack, receiving or dispatch records
  • Stocktake and inventory reports
  • Safety checklists and pre-start inspections
  • A reference from your warehouse supervisor or manager
licensingInfo: A qualification doesn't replace a licence. Forklifts and some other equipment need a high risk work licence from your state WHS regulator. If you hold one, it's useful evidence for RPL.
description:
The TLI30325 Certificate III in Supply Chain Operations covers skilled warehouse and logistics work. Core units are shifting materials safely and applying chain of responsibility rules. The rest is packaged around your work, such as warehousing, stock control, freight handling, equipment operation and transport.

It replaces TLI30321 and TLI30319.

faqs.q: Can I get a warehouse qualification through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you work in warehousing or logistics. Your licences, records and a supervisor's reference are assessed against the units.

faqs.q: Does it include a forklift licence?
faqs.a: No. A forklift licence is a high risk work licence issued after a separate assessment. If you hold one, it counts as evidence.
Usually 4 to 8 weeks.
Mostly. Evidence is submitted online, and your supervisor confirms your practical skills.
The cost depends on your evidence and any gap training. RPL is usually much cheaper than full study. Ask for a free eligibility check.

metaTitle: TLI40324 Cert IV Supply Chain Operations RPL
metaDescription: Supervise in logistics? Get the TLI40324 Certificate IV in Supply Chain Operations (formerly Cert IV in Logistics) through RPL. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The TLI40324 Certificate IV in Supply Chain Operations is the qualification for supervisors and coordinators in warehousing, transport and logistics. If you already run a shift, coordinate freight or monitor supply chain operations, RPL lets you get it using evidence from your role. It replaces the Certificate IV in Logistics.
whoIsItFor:
• Warehouse supervisors and shift leaders
  • Transport, freight and fleet coordinators
  • Logistics officers and supply chain coordinators
  • Distribution centre team leaders

Candidates usually have a few years in logistics, including supervising staff or coordinating operations, monitoring performance, managing safety and chain of responsibility duties, and fatigue management.
evidenceExamples:
• Rosters, allocation plans and shift reports
  • KPI and performance reports for your area
  • Chain of responsibility and fatigue management records
  • Incident reports and safety audits
  • Your licences and tickets
  • A reference from your operations or logistics manager
description:
The TLI40324 Certificate IV in Supply Chain Operations covers supervisory and coordination roles: implementing and monitoring chain of responsibility safety duties, monitoring supply chain operations and fatigue risk management, plus electives packaged around your work, such as warehousing, freight, transport, inventory and team leadership.

It replaces TLI40321 Certificate IV in Supply Chain Operations and TLI40319 Certificate IV in Logistics.

faqs.q: Can I get the Certificate IV in Supply Chain Operations through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you supervise or coordinate logistics work. Your rosters, reports, safety records and a manager's reference are assessed against the units.

faqs.q: Is this the same as the Certificate IV in Logistics?
faqs.a: It replaces it. TLI40319 Certificate IV in Logistics was superseded, and the current qualification for this kind of work is TLI40324.
Usually 4 to 8 weeks.
Mostly. Evidence is submitted online, and your workplace confirms your skills.
The cost depends on your evidence and any gap training. RPL is usually much cheaper than full study. Ask for a free eligibility check.

metaTitle: TLI50224 Diploma of Logistics RPL — Fast Track
metaDescription: Manage logistics or transport operations? Get the TLI50224 Diploma of Logistics through RPL using your experience. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The TLI50224 Diploma of Logistics is the management qualification for logistics, warehousing and transport. If you already manage operations, write procedures and oversee chain of responsibility duties, RPL lets you get it using evidence from your role. It replaces TLI50221.
whoIsItFor:
• Logistics and operations managers
  • Warehouse and distribution centre managers
  • Transport and fleet managers
  • Supply chain and inventory managers

You'll usually have several years in logistics, including managing people and operations, developing procedures, monitoring safety duties and improving performance.
evidenceExamples:
• Operating procedures you developed or reviewed
  • Chain of responsibility and safety records
  • KPI, budget and performance reports
  • Contracts, tenders or supplier reviews
  • A reference from your general manager
description:
The TLI50224 Diploma of Logistics covers managing logistics operations. The core units are implementing and monitoring chain of responsibility safety duties, and developing and maintaining operational procedures for transport and logistics businesses, plus technical and general electives in areas such as warehousing, inventory, freight, contracts, finance and people management.

It replaces TLI50221 and sits above the TLI40324 Certificate IV in Supply Chain Operations.

faqs.q: Can I get the Diploma of Logistics through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you manage logistics, warehousing or transport operations. Your procedures, reports and a reference are assessed against the units.
TLI50224 Diploma of Logistics is the current version and replaced TLI50221.
Usually 6 to 10 weeks.
Yes. Evidence is submitted online, and your workplace confirms your skills.
The cost depends on your evidence and any gap training. RPL is usually much cheaper than full study. Start with a free eligibility check.

metaTitle: TLI60222 Adv Diploma Supply Chain Management RPL
metaDescription: Lead supply chain operations? Get the TLI60222 Advanced Diploma of Supply Chain Management through RPL. Free eligibility check.
heroIntro: The TLI60222 Advanced Diploma of Supply Chain Management is the senior qualification for supply chain leaders. If you already set strategy, manage risk and lead teams across logistics or procurement, RPL lets you get it using evidence from your work.
whoIsItFor:
• Supply chain and logistics general managers
  • National or regional operations managers
  • Procurement and planning managers
  • Senior managers in transport and distribution

Candidates usually have many years in supply chain, including senior leadership, managing risk and putting policy into practice.
evidenceExamples:
• Strategy, business and improvement plans
  • Risk registers and risk reports
  • Policies you introduced and how you rolled them out
  • Leadership, budget and performance reports
  • A reference from your CEO, director or board
description:
The TLI60222 Advanced Diploma of Supply Chain Management covers senior supply chain leadership. The core units are providing leadership, managing risk and managing policy implementation, plus nine electives such as strategic planning, procurement, contracts, finance and logistics operations.

It replaces TLI60119 and sits above the TLI50224 Diploma of Logistics.
searchAliases: advanced diploma of supply chain management

faqs.q: Can I get the Advanced Diploma of Supply Chain Management through RPL?
faqs.a: Yes, if you lead supply chain or logistics operations. Your plans, risk reports, policies and a reference are assessed against the units.

faqs.q: Should I choose the Diploma of Logistics or this?
faqs.a: The Diploma of Logistics suits operations managers. The Advanced Diploma is for senior leaders responsible for strategy, risk and policy.
Usually 6 to 10 weeks.
Yes. Evidence is submitted online, and your workplace confirms your skills.
The cost depends on your evidence and any gap training. RPL is usually much cheaper than full study. Start with a free eligibility check.
